# ROYAL MARINE COMMANDOS [bold]THREE WORLD EMPIRE - IMPERIAL GARRISON, {colony}[/bold]
[bold]PART ONE ORDERS OF THE IMPERIAL GARRISON.[/bold] The following orders are issued by the Officer Commanding under the authority of the Provisional Governor, and take effect on promulgation. Residents are respectfully reminded that ignorance of a posted order is not an excuse.
Royal Marines have been deployed to {colony} to secure it on behalf of the Three World Empire. The Commando way is to arrive quietly, do the job properly, and leave the place tidier than we found it.
[color=#D4AF37]OFFICIAL - IMPERIAL SIGNALS - ALL TRAFFIC IS RECORDED[/color]
